title: Integrated Radioproteomic Modeling for Early Recurrence Prediction and Metabolic Characterization in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
snippet: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with high recurrence rates after surgical resection posing a significant challenge. title: Genomic Testing Uptake Among Medicare Beneficiaries With Cancer.
snippet: Genomic testing plays a central role in precision oncology by guiding targeted therapies. Medicare established national coverage determinations (NCDs) for next-generation sequencing (NGS) in 2018 and 2020, yet population-level adoption patterns remain underexamined.
